correctness.rationale: The centered ball operator on unweighted Q3 uses radii 0,1,2,3 with row denominators 1,4,7,8. For nonnegative g=|f|, selecting one maximizing radius at each of 8 vertices exactly represents ||Mg||² as a max over 4^8=65536 positive row-stochastic matrices, whose optimal 2-norm equals the top eigenvalue of A^T A. For either bipartition radius pattern (0 on one parity class, 1 on the other), the bipartite adjacency J-P has singular values (3,1,1,1), and the top Gram block (1/16)[[25,3],[3,1]] has eigenvalue (13+3sqrt(17))/16. Its unique positive eigenvector has parity profile (1,sqrt(17)-4); direct four-radius comparisons show intended radii are active. The pinned standard-library verify.py was inspected: it builds all 65536 assignments and uses fraction-free exact integer leading-minor checks on D=317*56²I-200(56A)^T(56A) for the other 65534, which is a valid Sylvester certificate with strict bound 317/200 < exceptional eigenvalue. An independent full 65536-case floating-point scan found exactly two cases above 317/200, both parity patterns (max 1.5855823048033, next 1.58378143449); this numeric scan corroborates rather than replaces the inspected exact certificate. Perron simplicity and strict inequality classify precisely the two labeled absolute-value norming rays, with arbitrary signs. Does not extend to higher cubes or other p.
